title: Alastair Ford on rare earths, gold & Apple getting serious on cobalt
text:
Alastair Ford on rare earths, gold & Apple getting serious on cobalt Share Download PDF version 11:14 22 Feb 2018 
Mining Capital's Alastair Ford chats through latest developments at Rainbow Rare Earths ( LON:RRE ), Orosur Mining ( LON:OMI ) and Wishbone Gold ( LON:WSBN ). 
Ford also discusses recent reports that US tech giant Apple Inc ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) is in talks to buy long-term supplies of cobalt directly from miners for the first time. 
The US$870mln company is one of the biggest end-users of the metal, which is a key battery ingredient for a lot of its products, including its popular iPhones. Meet Medusa Mining, Cora Gold, Group Eleven Resources Ltd., Harvest Minerals Ltd. and Crusader Resources Ltd at our event, London, 22 February 2018.
